summary: The sustained-playback verifier is now identity-safe and passed its known-good control three independent times. Sixteen distinct new-candidate videos were tested through KantaCue's existing official YouTube player: four passed sustained playback and twelve returned Error 150. All four technical passes remain quality tier C because audio, guide-vocal status, key, lyric sync, transitions, completeness, and presentation were not genuinely listened to/visually reviewed. Under the explicit quality gate, none qualifies for production addition yet. Existing 11 medleys and all 1067 primary records remain unchanged.

scopeAndEvidence.researchSources: Public YouTube watch/search pages, public descriptions/timestamps, existing KantaCue research ledgers, plus real-browser playback via KantaCue's existing controller. No YouTube Data API, API key, media download, proxy, or rehosting.

researchUniverse.note: The v2 research report counted 21 historical candidates plus 16 later candidates (37 distinct IDs). This pass added two additional distinct runtime candidates, Aegis and Eraserheads. Harana J Brothers was already in the v2 research universe and is now runtime-tested. IDs mentioned only as comparison notes are not counted as qualified candidates.

popularityMethod.facts: Public lifetime view-count snapshots and publication dates are recorded per candidate where captured. Candidate age is considered alongside views; view counts are not search volume.
popularityMethod.ageNormalization: Where both date and view snapshot exist, relative age is considered qualitatively. A lifetime average is not described as current velocity. Missing dates remain unknown.
popularityMethod.searchVolume: UNKNOWN; no reliable numerical search-volume source was used.
popularityMethod.trendOrVirality: UNKNOWN unless a time-series source establishes recent acceleration; no candidate is labelled viral or trending from lifetime views alone.

providerCoverage.result: One additional OPM love-song medley surfaced; it overlaps the existing generic OPM collection concept and returned Error 150. No addition.
Targeted public searches surfaced single-song videos/playlists, not a clearly documented one-video multi-song medley.
Targeted public searches did not establish a distinct multi-song karaoke video suitable for this phase.
The two candidates in this runtime batch both returned Error 150. Prior research also had four tested Sing King uploads return 150; no Sing King medley was promoted.
One very high-view MLTR medley passed sustained playback; manual audio/presentation review remains required.
Five candidates, including high-view OPM/international/duet entries, returned Error 150.
Scorpions and Eraserheads passed sustained playback; J Brothers returned Error 150.
A timestamped J Brothers medley passed sustained playback. It is the strongest of three tested J Brothers alternatives technically, but still requires human audio/presentation review.

Public searches also screened AJ KARAOKE COVER, PRO Music COVER, Clean Audio, Zoom Karaoke, Musisi Karaoke, 2Rs Kara-TV, KantaSonata, Cysoheartchannel, and KuyaPoy. No additional candidate met the combined distinctness/evidence bar for runtime promotion in this pass; PRO Music COVER's own description indicates melody-guide content, so it was not treated as a clean-guide-free source.

rootCauses: The YouTube API replaces the controller mount element with its iframe, so a mount-scoped iframe lookup could lose the active frame identity.

The iframe src retains the initial video ID while loadVideoById changes the active media. The controller's requested ID is not proof of the currently loaded media; stale playback could be misattributed.
The controller emits a synthetic load-accepted notification on later media loads. It must not be mistaken for a fresh YouTube onReady event.
The earlier sustained gate could accept early progression without sufficiently proving that playback continued through the end of the observation interval.
correction: Added a read-only controller query using the official player's getVideoUrl() to identify the actually loaded YouTube video.

The browser harness records requested ID, loaded ID, player-ready lifecycle, connected iframe, state, duration/time, visibility/focus, and per-second progression; stale state/errors are not attributed to a different requested ID.

PASS now requires a 15-second observation, at least eight readable samples spanning 12 seconds, fresh final sample, at least eight seconds net progression, five advancing intervals, and at least two advancing intervals in the final five seconds while visible.

The runner creates three independent browser processes/contexts for sample-029 before testing candidates. A failed control stops candidate qualification. Reports now count the control only after all required independent runs validate, rather than leaving it as a misleading UNTESTED/ambiguous row.

control.eachRun: PASS: official onReady, PLAYING, matching loaded video identity, connected iframe, visible document, 17 readable samples over approximately 15 seconds, about 15 seconds net currentTime advancement, and 15 advancing intervals including at least five in the final five seconds.

verifier.candidatePassSemantics: YouTube fires onReady for the player instance lifecycle, not for every loadVideoById media switch. The first candidate and the separately resumed Harana candidate each observed onReady. Other candidates reused the same already-ready official player; the audit recorded load-accepted, playerReady, matching actual getVideoUrl() identity, PLAYING, and sustained progression. Error 150 candidates were attributed only after the actual loaded video ID matched the requested ID.

qualityAndSelection.whyNoProductionAdditions: All four candidates that passed the embed/runtime gate still lack genuine listening/visual review of audio mix, lead/guide vocals, key, lyric timing, transitions, completeness, and presentation. The task explicitly requires C when these properties cannot be verified and permits production additions only at S/A/B. Thus zero additions is the evidence-correct outcome, not a quota shortfall.

finalVerification.pwa: Service-worker shell advanced from v109 to v110 because the cache-first shell includes src/youtube.js; this prevents an installed v109 shell from serving a stale audit controller. No other shell assets or cache behavior changed.
finalVerification.runtimeManualLimitations: No physical-device test, browser UI zoom test, network-offline transition test, or human audio/listening review was performed.

limitations: No genuine listening or visual review was performed in this environment; audio/key/guide vocals/lyric timing/transitions/presentation remain UNKNOWN for every new technical pass.
Runtime proof is from Windows HeadlessChrome 154 through a localhost origin and KantaCue's official IFrame Player API path. Device-specific production-browser acceptance was not performed.
YouTube public views and publication dates are snapshots; recent velocity and numerical search volume remain UNKNOWN.
The provider discovery was broad and targeted, not an exhaustive scrape of every channel's entire historical catalog.
releaseDecision: NO MEDLEYS ADDED. Preserve the existing 11. Offer the four technical-pass candidates for focused human listening/visual review before any future promotion.
